learnings.insight: Orchestrator gates (yarn typecheck, yarn test) fail locally when node_modules are not installed, even though CI installs them. The failure looks like a pre-existing bug but is actually a missing local install step.
learnings.action: Always run 'yarn install --frozen-lockfile' in orchestrator/ before running its gates locally.
